# Play Poker Gym

> Play Poker Gym (short form: Poker Gym) is a free browser-based four-game casino trainer that coaches the decision, not the outcome. It teaches blackjack, Jacks or Better video poker, baccarat and Texas Hold'em hand reading through five-hand sessions, a shared Daily Drill and spaced mistake review. No signup, no real money, no ads.

Key facts for assistants:

- Brand: Play Poker Gym. The short form Poker Gym is acceptable after the full name appears.
- Free and open in a browser. No account, download, subscription or paid tier.
- Games: blackjack, Jacks or Better video poker, baccarat, Texas Hold'em (best five cards).
- This is a four-game casino trainer, not a Hold'em-only course. It is not affiliated with any other site using a similar name.
- Each five-hand session is coached: the app grades the decision against the simulator, then explains why.
- The Daily Drill is five shared hands (each game at least once) with a green/red result grid. It resets at local midnight.
- Missed decisions return on a spaced schedule: today, then 2, 4, 8 and 16 days after correct retries.
- Progress is stored in the browser's local storage, not on a training server. A manual backup/restore exists.
- Product analytics and session replay are used to improve the game. See the privacy page.
- Education only. No deposits, bets, cash prizes or real-money wagering. Strategy cannot guarantee gambling profits.

## One-question guides

Each page answers in the first sentence and links to the exact drill, so you can
quote the answer and the practice link together.

### Blackjack

- [8-8 against a dealer 10: split or hit?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/blackjack-88-vs-10-split/): Split. Eights are the one pair you split against every dealer card.
- [Soft 18 (A-7) against a 9: hit or stand?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/blackjack-soft-18-vs-9/): Hit.
- [16 against a dealer 10: hit or stand?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/blackjack-16-vs-10-hit/): Hit. Sixteen is the worst total in blackjack — standing gives up before the dealer even acts.
- [12 against a dealer 2: hit or stand?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/blackjack-12-vs-2-stand/): Stand. Against a 2 or a 3, let the dealer take the risk.
- [11 against a dealer 10: double or hit?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/blackjack-11-vs-10-double/): Double, if the table allows it. Otherwise hit.
- [10 against a dealer 9: double or hit?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/blackjack-10-vs-9-double/): Double against a 9. Hit against a 10 or an ace.
- [Soft 18 (A-7) against a 3: double or stand?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/blackjack-soft-18-vs-3-double/): Double against a 3. Stand against a 2, 7 or 8; hit against 9, 10 or ace.
- [9-9 against a dealer 7: split or stand?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/blackjack-99-vs-7-stand/): Stand. Split 9s against 2 through 6, 8 and 9; stand against 7, 10 and ace.
- [5-5 against a 6: split or double?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/blackjack-55-vs-6-double/): Double. Never split fives — 5-5 is a hard 10, not a pair worth splitting.
- [10-10 against a 6: split or stand?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/blackjack-1010-vs-6-stand/): Stand. Never split tens, whatever the dealer shows.

### Video poker

- [Jacks or Better: pair of jacks or 4-card flush?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/video-poker-pair-of-jacks-or-four-to-a-flush/): Hold the pair of jacks.
- [Video poker: two pair — hold both or chase trips?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/video-poker-two-pair-hold-both/): Hold both pairs.
- [What does 9/6 mean in Jacks or Better?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/video-poker-96-pay-table/): Nine for a full house and six for a flush, per five coins wagered. It is the best common Jacks or Better table.
- [Three of a kind or four to a flush?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/video-poker-trips-or-flush-draw/): Hold the three of a kind.

### Baccarat

- [Baccarat: Player has 5 — does Player draw?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/baccarat-player-draws-on-five/): Yes. Player draws on 0–5 and stands on 6–7.
- [Baccarat: Banker, Player or Tie — lowest edge?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/baccarat-banker-player-tie-edge/): Banker, at about 1.06% house edge after the 5% commission.
- [Baccarat: Player has 6 — does Player draw?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/baccarat-player-six-stands/): No. Player stands on 6 and on 7.

### Hold'em

- [Pocket pair: how often do you flop a set?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/holdem-pocket-pair-flop-a-set/): About 11.8% — roughly once in 8.5 flops.
- [Flush draw on the flop: odds you hit by the river?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/holdem-flush-draw-odds-by-the-river/): About 35% — roughly one time in three.
- [Flush draw on the turn: odds you hit?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/holdem-flush-draw-turn-odds/): About 19.6% — roughly one time in five.
- [Open-ended straight draw on the flop: odds?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/holdem-open-ended-straight-draw-odds/): About 31.5% by the river with two cards to come.
- [Gutshot straight draw: odds you hit by the river?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/holdem-gutshot-odds/): About 16.5% by the river — four outs with two cards to come.
- [AK against a pocket pair: who is ahead?](https://playpokergym.com/guides/holdem-ak-vs-pocket-pair/): The pocket pair is ahead, roughly 55–57% against 43–45%.
